title: Green light-responsive photoelectrochemical sensing nanoplatform based on copper cobaltite nanorods for ultrasensitive detection of furazolidone antibiotic residue in food samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3122-3138
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08497G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Ngoc Huyen, Xuan-Dinh Ngo, Vu Thi Huong Mai, Phung Thi Lan Huong, Pham Duc Thang, Le-Anh Tuan
In this study, we describe experimental efforts to understand the effect of laser light irradiation on the performance of CuCo2O4-based electrochemical sensor for the detection of furazolidone antibiotic.
